rule: Sort key = (author_id, author_seq, hlc_counter). wall_ms is display-only and MUST NOT gate replication or expiry. P0/P1 are always accepted regardless of author clock skew.

cases.name: p0_future_clock_not_suppressed

cases.note: a skewed author clock cannot suppress a life-safety SOS
